title: Betti Numbers of Sequentially Cohen-Macaulay Co-Chordal Graphs and Their Applications
summary: We study sequentially Cohen-Macaulay co-chordal graphs through the glued clique complexes of their chordal complements. Using the characterization of these complements as $(d_1,\ldots,d_q)$-trees, we derive explicit formulas for the graded Betti numbers of the associated edge ideals, yielding a complete homological characterization of sequentially Cohen-Macaulay co-chordal graphs. As applications, we determine exact homological invariants for several important graph families, including split graphs, threshold graphs, and prime ideal graphs, and classify their Cohen-Macaulay cases. We further characterize the sequentially Cohen-Macaulay nilpotent graphs of finite direct products of Artinian chain rings and establish a closed formula for their graded Betti numbers in terms of local nilpotency indices and residue field cardinalities. Finally, we classify the zero-divisor graphs of $\mathbb{Z}_n$, proving that they are sequentially Cohen-Macaulay if and only if $n=2p$ or $n=p^a$, where $p$ is a prime.

AI.tldr: 通过 chordal 补图的 glued clique complex，给出了 sequentially Cohen-Macaulay (SCM) co-chordal 图的完整同调刻画，并算出其 edge ideal 的 graded Betti 数显式公式。
AI.motivation: SCM 性质是交换代数与组合的交叉核心。co-chordal 图（补图为 chordal）的 edge ideal 结构清晰，但其 SCM 性与 Betti 数尚缺乏统一刻画。把补图刻画为 $(d_1,\ldots,d_q)$-tree 提供了突破口。
AI.method: 用 chordal 补图的 glued clique complex 建模；借助 $(d_1,\ldots,d_q)$-tree 的刻画计算 graded Betti 数；对 split graph、threshold graph、prime ideal graph 等族分别应用。
AI.result: 给出 SCM co-chordal 图的完整同调刻画和 edge ideal 的 graded Betti 数显式公式；确定 split/threshold/prime ideal 图的精确同调不变量；刻画 Artinian chain ring 有限直积的 SCM nilpotent 图；证明 $\mathbb{Z}_n$ 的 zero-divisor 图 SCM 当且仅当 $n=2p$ 或 $n=p^a$。
AI.conclusion: 补图的 chordal 结构把 SCM 性完全转化为可计算的同调数据，统一处理了多个重要图族与代数结构。
AI.future_work: 推广到更一般（非 co-chordal）图类；探索 glued clique complex 框架在其他单项式理想同调问题中的应用。

title: Proof of the Finiteness of the Chromatic Number of Two-Dimensional Lacunary Distance Graphs
summary: We extend the one-dimensional lonely set method to two dimensions for the purpose of studying the chromatic number of integer distance graphs in two dimensions. Given a lacunary sequence of displacement vectors in $Z^{2}$, we use a lacunary matrix theorem given by Broderick, Fishman and Kleinbock, to prove the existence of a satisfactory multiplier vector. We then give an explicit geometric colouring argument. This proves that any integer distance graph generated by a lacunary sequence of vectors in two dimensions has finite chromatic number.

AI.tldr: 把一维 lonely set 方法推广到二维，证明由 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 中 lacunary 位移向量序列生成的整数距离图有有限的 chromatic number。
AI.motivation: 整数距离图的 chromatic number 是组合数论与几何着色的经典问题。一维 lacunary 情形有 lonely set 方法，但二维缺乏对应工具。
AI.method: 将一维 lonely set 方法推广到二维；利用 Broderick–Fishman–Kleinbock 的 lacunary 矩阵定理构造满足条件的 multiplier 向量；再给出显式的几何着色论证。
AI.result: 证明任意由二维 lacunary 向量序列生成的整数距离图都有有限 chromatic number。
AI.conclusion: lonely set 方法可跨维推广，lacunary 结构足以保证距离图的可着色有限性。
AI.future_work: 推广到更高维 $\mathbb{Z}^d$；给出 chromatic number 的显式上界或最优值。

title: Excluding an induced star in dense random graphs
summary: For fixed $k\geq3$, we study the asymptotic number and typical structure of dense graphs with no induced copy of the star $K_{1,k}$. We solve the associated graphon variational problems both at fixed constant edge density $γ$ and for the conditioned Erdős--Rényi random graph $G(n,p)$ for constant $p$. As consequences, we obtain explicit formulas for the entropy density of induced-$K_{1,k}$-free graphs with $Θ(n^2)$ edges and for the large deviation rate function for the event that $G(n,p)$ is induced-$K_{1,k}$-free. The entropy density exhibits a second-order phase transition at an explicit critical density $γ_k$, while the rate function exhibits a first-order phase transition at a critical parameter $p_k$. We completely characterize the optimizers of both variational problems. Both models have parameter values for which there are infinitely many optimal graphons, but there is always a unique graphon that represents the typical structure in cut metric. We refine the graphon-level results by giving a detailed structural description of both models. For supercritical parameters, each random graph model is the complement of a $(k-1)$-partite graph with high probability. In the subcritical regime of the fixed-density model, the typical structure is the disjoint union of the complement of a $(k-1)$-partite graph, and a sparse remainder. In the subcritical regime of the conditioned Erdős--Rényi random graph, a typical sample has $o(n^2)$ edges.

AI.tldr: 求解了 induced $K_{1,k}$-free 稠密图的 graphon 变分问题，给出熵密度与 large deviation rate function 的显式公式，并揭示二阶/一阶相变。
AI.motivation: 禁止诱导星 $K_{1,k}$ 的稠密图的典型结构与计数是随机图大偏差理论的自然问题。固定边密度与条件 Erdős–Rényi 两种模型下的极值 graphon 此前未知。
AI.method: 求解固定边密度 $\gamma$ 与条件 $G(n,p)$ 两种 graphon 变分问题；用 cut metric 刻画唯一典型 graphon；对超临界/亚临界区间做结构分析。
AI.result: 给出 induced-$K_{1,k}$-free 图（$\Theta(n^2)$ 条边）熵密度与 $G(n,p)$ induced-$K_{1,k}$-free 事件 rate function 的显式公式；熵密度在临界密度 $\gamma_k$ 处二阶相变，rate function 在 $p_k$ 处一阶相变；超临界下典型结构为 $(k-1)$-部图的补，亚临界下为其补与稀疏余项的不交并。
AI.conclusion: 禁止诱导星的稠密图结构由 $(k-1)$-部补图主导，且相变行为在两种模型中形态不同，完全刻画了变分最优子。
AI.future_work: 推广到其他禁止诱导子图；研究临界点处的精细涨落与非唯一最优 graphon 的选择机制。

title: Finite-Kernel Extremizers in Sparse Extremal Graph Counting
summary: We develop a finite-kernel framework for sparse extremal graph counting. The problems considered here ask for the maximum number of copies or homomorphisms of a fixed graph under sparse edge constraints. In this regime, the leading term need not be governed by a single dense block. Instead, the extremal mass may be supported on several interacting asymptotic scales. Our framework identifies these scales via a finite-dimensional linear program, separates the leading contributions through a finite state decomposition, and synchronizes or realizes them inside a finite kernel. We apply this framework in three settings. First, we prove the sparse threshold conjecture of Day and Sarkar for graphons. For every fixed graph $H$ without isolated vertices, we prove that \[ \sup_{t(K_2,W)\le β} t(H,W)=β^{|V(H)|-α^*(H)}(C_T(H)+o(1)) \] as $β\to0$, where $α^*(H)$ is the fractional independence number of $H$ and $C_T(H)$ is an explicit sharp constant attained by a three-step threshold graphon. Second, we affirmatively answer a question of Blekherman and Patel by showing that, for every graph $H$, whenever $m\to\infty$ and $m=o(n^{3/2})$, threshold graphs asymptotically maximize $\hom(H,G)$ among all graphs with at most $n$ vertices and at most $m$ edges. Third, Gerbner, Nagy, Patkós, and Vizer conjectured that, among all bipartite graphs with $n$ vertices and $m$ edges, the quasi-complete bipartite graph asymptotically maximizes the number of copies of every fixed bipartite graph $H$ whenever $m=ω(n)$ and $m\le n^2/4$. We disprove this conjecture in the subquadratic range and give the correct order of magnitude in terms of $κ_H(n,m)$, a finite-kernel scale defined by a finite-dimensional variational problem.

AI.tldr: 提出 finite-kernel 框架处理稀疏极值图计数，证明了 Day–Sarkar 的 sparse threshold 猜想，肯定回答 Blekherman–Patel 的问题，并否证了 Gerbner–Nagy–Patkós–Vizer 猜想。
AI.motivation: 稀疏边约束下固定图 $H$ 的最大拷贝/同态数，其主项常不由单一稠密块决定，而分布在多个相互作用的渐近尺度上，缺乏统一处理框架。
AI.method: 用有限维线性规划识别渐近尺度，通过有限状态分解分离主项，并在 finite kernel 中同步/实现这些尺度。
AI.result: 证明对无孤立点的 $H$，$\sup_{t(K_2,W)\le\beta}t(H,W)=\beta^{|V(H)|-\alpha^*(H)}(C_T(H)+o(1))$（三步 threshold graphon 达到）；证明 $m=o(n^{3/2})$ 时 threshold 图渐近最大化 $\hom(H,G)$；在亚二次范围否证 quasi-complete 二部图最优的猜想并给出正确量级 $\kappa_H(n,m)$。
AI.conclusion: finite-kernel 框架统一了稀疏极值计数中多尺度现象，一举解决/推翻了三个相关猜想。
AI.future_work: 刻画 $\kappa_H(n,m)$ 的精确常数；将框架推广到超图与其他稀疏计数问题。
